en-US.name: Supperwise: Meal Planner
en-US.subtitle: Family dinners under budget
en-US.promotionalText: Nearly 300 family dinners, planned under your grocery budget and priced by the pack. New: snap any meal for a 1–100 health score. Your first week is free to keep.
en-US.description:
Plan a week of dinners your whole family can eat, and see what the groceries will cost before you leave the house.

Supperwise builds the week and the shopping list together, for the kind of store you use, and keeps the total under the budget you set. It prices the pack you actually buy, not the spoonful you use.

HOW IT WORKS
• Enter your ZIP code and the kind of store you shop at.
• Tell it who's eating, which nights you cook and what you want to spend.
• Get a week of dinners and one grocery list with a total.

EVERYONE AT THE TABLE
• Diets, allergies (including sesame) and spice levels, person by person. Dishes with an allergen someone avoids are never planned.
• When a dish has meat, there's a written vegetarian plate for whoever needs one.
• Nearly 300 recipes from Italian to Indian, Mexican to Korean, with exact amounts and safe cooking temperatures.

A LIST THAT MATCHES THE CHECKOUT
• Priced by the whole pack, and ingredients shared across the week are bought once.
• Tick what you already have and it comes off the bill.
• Swap any night with one tap; the list reprices.

PLANS
• Plus: a new week every Sunday, swaps, cook mode with timers, Thanksgiving and Christmas menus with a one-oven timeline, community recipes.
• Family: everything in Plus, plus nut-free school lunches on the same list, first foods for babies, food scan (snap a meal for a 1–100 score, calories and what's likely in it), barcode scanner, eating-out scores, leftovers, receipt check and a weekly recap.
• Pro: everything in Family, plus a fridge scan that finds what you can cook tonight.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your household, allergies and plans stay on your iPhone. An account is only needed to share recipes or scan food.

PRICES AND ESTIMATES
Grocery prices are estimates for your type of store and region, not live prices from any retailer. Food-scan nutrition is an estimate from a photo. Supperwise isn't affiliated with any grocery store and isn't medical advice: always check labels for allergies.

YOUR FIRST WEEK IS FREE
Plan your first week and keep it, list and all. To plan every week after, subscribe monthly or yearly (yearly plans start with a 1-week free trial). Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
